blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Rhenz Abando is making his return for Gilas Pilipinas after being included in the 12-man roster for the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers. The Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas made the announcement on Wednesday, with Abando being one of the notable names on the roster that will aim for victories over Syria and Iran later this month in Seremban, Malaysia. Debuting Bennie Boatwright is also on the roster as a naturalized player, while Quentin Millora-Brown and Mike Phillips are going to make a comeback after skipping the previous window.
